spec.description:
MCPClientSpec defines the desired state of MCPClient.

An MCPClient describes how EDA connects to a remote MCP server
over Streamable HTTP, how it authenticates, and which primitives
(tools, resources, prompts) it imports from that server.

auth.description:
Authentication configuration for the remote MCP server.
Exactly one of bearer or clientCredentials must be specified.
Only auth modes that can complete without human interaction are
supported, since MCPClient is applied declaratively via the API.

bearer.description:
Static bearer token / API key authentication.
The token is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every
request to the remote MCP server.

key.description: Key within the Secret's data map.
key.title: Key

bearer.title: Bearer

clientCredentials.description:
OAuth 2.1 client_credentials flow (machine-to-machine).
EDA exchanges its client credentials for an access token at
the configured token endpoint and refreshes the token as
needed.

audience.description: Optional audience (`aud`) claim to request on the token.
audience.title: Audience

clientAuthMethod.description: How the client credentials are sent to the token endpoint.
clientAuthMethod.title: Client Authentication

clientID.description: OAuth client identifier issued to EDA by the authorization server.
clientID.title: Client ID

clientSecretRef.description: Reference to a Secret containing the OAuth client secret.

key.description: Key within the Secret's data map.
key.title: Key

tokenURL.title: Token URL

description.description: A brief description of the remote MCP server.

and no primitives are imported.

endpoint.description: Endpoint configuration for reaching the remote MCP server.

headers.description:

remote MCP server. Headers carrying secrets should reference a

remote primitives) in seconds. Default 60 seconds.
